claims.summary: For every prime p and every field F of characteristic p, on A=F[x_1,...,x_p]/(x_i^2-x_i), the pairing extracting the coefficient of x_1...x_p from fg is nondegenerate on A but has radical dimension p-1 on A^(S_p). The radical consists exactly of invariant functions supported on Hamming weights1,...,p-1. Thus invariant primal attainment does not justify restricting all multiplier dual tests to invariants.
claims.assessment: Working elementary all-prime proof by cube interpolation and the diagonal orbit weights (-1)^(p-w) binom(p,w). The same medium reviewer passed it including p2. This refutes only a proposed lossy modular compression, not the full coefficient dual or symmetric polynomial descent.
claims.rationale: Route-specific negative control for the independent filtered-fat-cube architecture. Standard orbit-count arithmetic; no independent novelty claim and no new per-order threshold.
claims.next_action: Retain full coefficient-dual coinvariants in any proposed filtered recurrence; require an actual missing threshold before claiming goal progress.

relationships: The obstruction concerns invariant multiplier tests; it does not contradict the established invariant primal kernel/top-image attainment.
